title: Review Checkpoint: Universal Auth Probes Working Across Stacks
goal: After #325-#328, verify the 5 migrated probes actually find vulnerabilities on at least 2 non-Gruyere targets, Gruyere parity is preserved, the cache is working, and no Gruyere-specific patterns remain in production code. Decide go/no-go for Phase 3.
scope: Operator + agent review of work from backlog-375, -376, -377, -378. Live run of the generality test across Gruyere + juice-shop + demo.testfire.net + testasp.vulnweb.com. Written checkpoint report with go/no-go on Phase 3.
generation_reason: Per operator request, a checkpoint after Phase 2 confirms the universal-auth investment paid off before Phase 3 (picker hardening + structured outputs) is started.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Review only. No production code changes. Output is a checkpoint report and a yes/no decision on Phase 3 promotion.
constraints.evidence_requirement: Checkpoint report must cite real findings_count numbers from the generality matrix, not aspirational claims.

success_criteria: docs/checkpoints/2026-mythos-phase2-review.md exists with: (a) generality matrix (5 probes x 4 targets), (b) Gruyere parity confirmation, (c) cache hit rate observed during testing, (d) deviation from #325-#328 plans if any, (e) explicit go/no-go for Phase 3.
At least 3 of the 5 probes produce at least 1 finding on at least 1 non-Gruyere target (no longer silent no-op).
Auth recipe cache is observed serving hits on second-run replay (logged).
AGENT_SYSTEM_MAP.md section 3 is updated to reflect that the 5 probes are now Verified-generic.
If go: backlog-380 is promoted into NEXT_TASK.md. If no-go: corrective task is named and queued.

acceptance_criteria: Generality matrix is captured in the checkpoint report.
Phase 3 go/no-go decision is explicit and justified by the matrix data.
Any deviation from #375-#378 scope is named.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
Tasks #325, #326, #327, #328 must show as DONE in DONE_LOG.md.
after_completion: Promote backlog-380 (or corrective task) into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Reopening Phase 2 scope unless drift is documented.
